notes.title: Co-op and Achievements
notes.content:
-Now you don't need to be linked to an EGS account to play Noch. This is true for both single-player and co-op.

-Achievements are working again.

-Some other game bugs have been fixed.

The situation with EGS and broken achievements has taken up a lot of our resources over the past few weeks. Both are very important to the game and all of our resources have been thrown into fixing them. 

We are back to regular weekly patches and will try to fix any remaining issues as soon as possible.

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
[b]Better late than never: 
EGS login is now needed for Co-op only.[/b]

We understand the frustration of players regarding linking Noch with EGS. Throughout development we've tried to make login as simple as possible, and the current solution is the least of the evils we've chosen.

-Now you don't need to login to EGS to play single-player game
-No Epic Games Launcher or Epic Games Services is required for both co-op and single-player
-If you want to play with a friend, you both need to select "Play Co-op" option in the main menu and login to your EGS account via browser
-For co-op play you will only need to login to your EGS account once
-You don't need to login to your EGS account again if you have already done so


Q: Why do I need to login to EGS?
A: The fact that the EGS network is supported at all marketplaces makes cross-play possible for players from different stores

Q: Why was EGS login required for everyone before this update?
A: We were experiencing problems integrating the EGS network into the game. Logging to EGS for everyone was the most reliable solution to avoid login problems for most players. It was also assumed that most players would play in co-op mode. Now that we see that this is not the case, we recognize and correct our mistakes

[b]Character getting stuck[/b]

There is now a "Respawn" option in the pause menu.
The Respawn feature solves most of the problems with a character getting stuck without loading with a checkpoint

[b]Many other bugs have also been fixed in the patch, including:[/b]

-Localization bugs
-Found collision issues
-Problems with optimization of some scenes
-Other serious bugs in the game

[b]Other news: Noch Soundtrack coming soon[/b]

Many players like Noch's music and we plan to publish the game soundtrack early next week

notes.title: Full access is available now!
notes.content:
Noch is here! The final chapter of the story is already available on Steam.

We dedicated 3.5 years of our lives to creating this dozen hours of gameplay, and they were not the easiest years.

This game is:
[list]
[*] The most complex story we dared to tell
[*] Several hours of voiceovers
[*] One and a half hours of hand-crafted cutscenes
[*] A collaboration with three amazing musical collectives
[*] And a few (hopefully) amusing bugs
[/list]

Whether we can continue to make narrative cooperative games in the future or not, we don't even know ourselves. We've done everything we could. Now it's your turn. Leave reviews, tell your friends about the game, and share it.

We entrust our fate to the hands of our players.

All the best and thanks for the fish!

notes.title: Welcome to Lisaland 3:2
notes.content:
The new chapter Lisaland 3:2 is available now!
This is the last chapter before the full release. Next one will be the last! 

Lisaland is waiting for you - the once beautiful amusement park full of fun no longer looks so cheerful. What secrets are hidden in the sand-covered shatters of the past, what happened here, and what do you and Lisa have to do with it? You will find the answer to these and other questions by talking to the inhabitants of this godforsaken place.

[b]What new in Lisaland 3:2 [/b]
-Communication with characters
-The most spacious location in the game
-Even more walkthrough freedom
-New boss - Champion of Colosseum 
-The journal with notes now alway accessible in the main menu
-More secrets and mysteries

[b]The patch also fixes many bugs and shortcomings, here are the main ones:[/b]
-Fixed Epic Online Service login algorithm
-Improved network optimization
-Steam achievements fixed
-Added and improved sounds in all previous chapters
-Fixed critical bugs in the behavior of enemies
-Fixed many other minor bugs

notes.title: January progress update
notes.content:
We are actively working on Chapter 3:2, in which the player will have at his disposal a spacious location fraught with many stories and secrets - [b]Lisaland![/b]

🌜The environment of Lisaland is 80% ready - check out the beauty of the location in the screenshots at the end of the news!

🌜We also decided to introduce a new type of interaction with the environment - a dialogue system! This will allow players to:
[list]
[*]chat with NPCs and learn their stories
[*]to understand in more detail what is actually happening in this godforsaken world
[*]and even complete some tasks
[/list]
Due to the dialogues, the non-linearity of the passage of Noch will reach a new level: the development of the plot will depend on the player (that is, on you). As you agree (and with whom!), so be it.

🌜And, of course, in Lisaland, players will meet a new powerful boss. To win in an unequal battle, you will have to pay special attention to the enemy's techniques and find a unique approach to protecting the enemy. [i]We do not recommend acting directly![/i]

notes.title: Second chapter is HERE!

[previewyoutube=C9YfWjeKb8c;full][/previewyoutube]

There was a hard choice - to cut and burn part of Noch to make it faster and shorter, Or tell the story the way it appeared in our heads and later. We want to tell the whole story. To be epic.

notes.title: Noch is released!
notes.content:
Introducing the Night… First 3 hours of mysterious adventure in deceased world starting now! 
Fourth project of Fair Games. And again we will say that we collected all experience from previous projects to put it into something new. 

Shortly Noch is an ominous surreal first-person adventure full of dangerous monsters and secrets of the deceased world. But who can tell what is the reason that everything falling apart? Why all you have in your head is that Lisa disappeared and you have to save her no matter what? Is it coincidence? Or maybe the reason is deeper and you have to dig a little and find the Truth?
